2685-4186-7743-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2685-4186-7743-7810.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

1987-2493-3110.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-2493-3110.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Archaeomancer.
When Archaeomancer enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2493-3110.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

1558-4840-7650.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Bilbo.
1558-4840-7650.description:
Declare Bilbo as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing you to cast Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard by paying {6}.
When Myr Battlesphere enters, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing Myr Battlesphere and sacrificing the four Myr tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2511-6871-6879-7223.description:
Cast Stalactite Dagger by paying {2}.
When Stalactite Dagger enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Shapeshifter creature token with changeling.
When the Shapeshifter enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Stalactite Dagger, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Stalactite Dagger.
When Stalactite Dagger dies, Haru triggers, returning Stalactite Dagger from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 once.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 4.

1734-2511-3175.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sun Titan from exile to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 3.

283-1432-7163.easyPrerequisites: You are able to put a triggered ability on the stack.
283-1432-7163.description:
Put any triggered ability on the stack.
Holding priority, activate Mister Fantastic by paying {R}{G}{W}{U} and tapping it, targeting that ability.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers. Holding priority, activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, untapping Mister Fantastic.
Activate Mister Fantastic by paying {R}{G}{W}{U} and tapping it, copying Illusionist's Bracers' trigger twice
Resolve the first copy of Illusionist Bracers' trigger, copying Mister Fantastic's ability, targeting Illusionist's Bracers' trigger.
Resolve the copy of Mister Fantastic's ability, copying Illusionist's bracers' trigger twice.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-2700-6972.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Arcbound Shikari.
When Arcbound Shikari dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Shikari's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Shikari from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

457-1329-3338-3836-7112.description:
If Aether Spellbomb is in your graveyard, activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Aether Spellbomb.
Cast Aether Spellbomb either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Urza.
Mirran Spy triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Aether Spellbomb, adding {U}.
Activate Aether Spellbomb's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

874-969-1170-1329.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-969-1170-1329.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Delif's Cone from your graveyard.
Cast Delif's Cone by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1850-5967-6620.description:
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-5967-6620.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

uses.n: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar

2091-4558-5913-6798.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least ten tapped lands.
2091-4558-5913-6798.description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Extus triggers, returning Pinnacle Monk from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Mana Geyser, adding {R} for each tapped land your opponents control.
Cast Pinnacle Monk by paying its mana cost.
When Pinnacle Monk enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Geyser from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Pinnacle Monk.
Repeat.

618-2921-3580.description:
Cast Lightning Crafter by paying {3}{R}.
When Lightning Crafter enters the battlefield, its champion ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Lightning Crafter with haste.
When the token Lightning Crafter enters the battlefield, its champion ability triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki.
Activate the token Lightning Crafter by tapping it, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the token Lightning Crafter.
When the token Lightning Crafter leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 3.

222-527-1251-3967.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-1251-3967.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core

3869-4067-6071.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four permanent cards in your graveyard.
3869-4067-6071.description:
Activate The Core by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Gretchen by tapping {2}{G}{U}, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping The Core.
Repeat.

225-2660-3897-5094.notablePrerequisites:
Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-2660-3897-5094.description:
Activate Terramorphic Expanse by tapping and sacrificing it.
Terramorphic Expanse is put on the bottom of your library instead of in your graveyard due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Resolve the Terramorphic Expanse ability, searching your library for Terramorphic Expanse and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
Terramorphic Expanse enters the battlefield, triggering Stone-Seeder Hierophant, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Terramorphic Expanse.
Repeat.

893-3698-4853.description:
Activate Myr Turbine by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
When the Myr enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Myr.
When the Myr dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Myr Turbine.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability.
Repeat.
